desc: Establish monotonicity and reduction to interval coverage after selecting complement operations.
Establish that at most two complement operations are needed.
Prove or replace the two-complement candidate reduction, including overlapping intervals and identity exclusions.
Replace repeated linear greedy covering with a subquadratic jump/binary-lifting data structure.
Debug the current implementation’s runtime error on Sample 1 and validate all samples.
Exhaustively validate minimum costs and reconstructed operations against brute force after optimization.
Confirm worst-case runtime and memory for maximal adversarial inputs.
Resolve the sample-output mismatch as a checker-format issue: `0 1 1 0` is a valid cost-2 solution, though exact-text comparison reports it differently.
